changelog: Your agent is better at noticing when someone you know holds the answer, it does what you asked before it offers a draft, and /vibe has a quieter voice.
features: Your agent now sees each person's full line about what they are working on, and who you share an open line with, and may offer a message when your work plainly touches theirs
It asks the person who knows before guessing, and says in a few words what was already checked
It does what you asked first; a draft you did not ask for comes after, never instead
A new draft shows what was already said in that conversation, so follow-ups say only what is new
Before saying there is nothing to add to a question, it looks in the project, and says what it searched
The preview says how the message will reach the other person, and flags someone you have not written to before
A message arriving mid-work reads: Note from @name (2m ago), waiting at your pause
When a reply changes what you do, your agent can offer a one-line note back to say so; it goes only if you choose
Text written by other people is more thoroughly marked as theirs, so it cannot read as /vibe's own words
